title: Reply composer: no status on send, no ticket number in the subject, short toolbar

panels.caption: Zoho help: send options and subject
text: Send and update status: choose a status (for example "Waiting for customer reply") at send time from the Send drop-down.
The ticket ID is included in the subject of outgoing replies by default; each department can hide it ("Hide Ticket ID in Outgoing Replies").
